name: 42651-soloimagechat-qwen25vl7b-1gpu
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3 (one whole a3 node, `--gres=gpu:8`). The node must be idle: the engine is built at tensor-parallel 8, so a neighbour on any one card changes the number.
parallelism: TP=8, PP=1, DP=1, V1 engine core, one in-process vLLM engine over eight ranks.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams = 32, 32 warmup requests by count, bounded at 288 requests with a 1800 s safety cap. Thirty-two requests are in flight at every instant, which is the unbounded-arrival / capped-concurrency point the source ran.
workload: single-turn text completion: 16 synthetic input tokens in, 1024 output tokens out, 288 requests bounded and 256 scored. Prompt and output lengths are fixed (min = max = mean). In guidellm this is `synthetic_text`; the engine is driven in-process through guidellm's `vllm_python` backend.
purpose: A code-completion assistant generating long snippets from short prompts, 32 concurrent streams on one eight-GPU node.
launch:
# Engine: commit 363fc84407f8c966c1cee6786e45e9e6ab289684 (v0.21.1rc0-151-g363fc84407f8).
# Nothing here is tuned: there is no tuned.yaml and no tunable.yaml.
#
# LOAD-BEARING and not defaults:
#   * `tensor-parallel-size: 8`. Eight-way sharding is the declared width and is not
#     interchangeable with any other here -- this checkpoint's own dimensions are all
#     multiples of 16 (hidden 2048, intermediate 10944, moe_intermediate 1408) and the
#     per-rank shapes are what the deployment is about.
#   * `enable-prefix-caching: false`. Prompts are 16 synthetic tokens and block-size is 16, so
#     one shared leading block would answer a whole prompt out of cache.
#   * `max-num-batched-tokens: 8192`. `vllm serve` picks 8192 on a card of this class while an
#     engine constructed in-process falls back to 2048. It does not bind at these lengths.

model: RedHatAI/DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct-FP8
tensor-parallel-size: 8
pipeline-parallel-size: 1

# The checkpoint's own window is 163840 (yarn, original 4096). Every request here is 16 in plus
# 1024 out, so 4096 is above the worst case and keeps the KV profile deterministic.
max-model-len: 4096

enable-prefix-caching: false
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
block-size: 16
dtype: bfloat16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
